AlertName: Possible ransomware-like encryption behavior - behavioral profile v3
OutputType: Alerta RT / Discord recomendado solo tras validar JSONL
CU_Reason: Strong PowerShell crypto/encryption indicators
CU_Evidence:
$base = "C:\Users\seguridad\Desktop\TFM"
$out = Join-Path $base "diag_p3v3"
$jsonl = "\\VBOXSVR\Carpeta_Compartida_TFM\inbox\alerts.jsonl"

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $out | Out-Null

# Limpiar JSONL
Clear-Content $jsonl

# Marcador temporal
$t0 = Get-Date
"START=$($t0.ToString('o'))" | Out-File "$out\00_time_marker.txt" -Encoding utf8

# Ejecutar campaña
Set-ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Scope Process -Force
cd $base
.\runner_candidate\TFM_Run_All_TEC_Tests_v2.ps1 *>&1 | Tee-Object "$out\01_runner_console.txt"

$t1 = Get-Date
"END=$($t1.ToString('o'))" | Add-Content "$out\00_time_marker.txt"

# Copiar JSONL
Copy-Item $jsonl "$out\02_alerts.jsonl" -Force

# Copiar último log del runner
$latestLog = Get-ChildItem "$base\Pruebas\Logs_Pruebas_TFM\TFM_TEC_Run_CANDIDATE_v2_*.log" |
Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending |
Select-Object -First 1

if ($latestLog) {
    Copy-Item $latestLog.FullName "$out\03_runner_latest.log" -Force
}

# Resumen JSONL
$alerts = Get-Content $jsonl | Where-Object { $_.Trim() } | ConvertFrom-Json

$alerts.Count | Out-File "$out\04_alerts_count.txt" -Encoding utf8

$alerts |
Group-Object CU_ID |
Sort-Object Name |
Select-Object Name,Count |
Out-File "$out\05_alerts_by_CU.txt" -Encoding utf8

$alerts |
Group-Object SourceArtifact |
Sort-Object Count -Descending |
Select-Object Name,Count |
Out-File "$out\06_alerts_by_SourceArtifact.txt" -Encoding utf8

$alerts |
Where-Object { $_.CU_ID -in @('CU-006','CU-007','CU-008','CU-009') } |
Select-Object CU_ID,MITRE_ID,SourceArtifact,AlertName,CU_Reason,CU_Evidence |
Format-List |
Out-File "$out\07_alerts_CU006_009_detail.txt" -Width 2000 -Encoding utf8

# PowerShell 4104
$pat4104 = "SecurityCenter2|AntivirusProduct|Get-CimInstance|Get-WmiObject|wmic|Win32_Service|Get-ChildItem|Remove-Item|ForEach-Object|Compress-Archive|Copy-Item|TcpClient|Connect|AES|CryptoStream|CreateEncryptor|\.aes"

$ps4104 = Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{
    LogName="Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational"
    Id=4104
    StartTime=$t0
    EndTime=$t1
} -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

$ps4104 |
Where-Object { $_.Message -match $pat4104 } |
Select-Object TimeCreated,Id,Message |
Format-List |
Out-File "$out\08_powershell_4104_relevant.txt" -Width 4000 -Encoding utf8

[PSCustomObject]@{
    CU006_4104 = @($ps4104 | Where-Object { $_.Message -match "SecurityCenter2|AntivirusProduct|Get-CimInstance|Get-WmiObject|wmic|Win32_Service" }).Count
    CU007_4104 = @($ps4104 | Where-Object { $_.Message -match "AES|CryptoStream|CreateEncryptor|\.aes" }).Count
    CU008_4104 = @($ps4104 | Where-Object { $_.Message -match "Get-ChildItem|Remove-Item|ForEach-Object|-Force" }).Count
    CU009_4104 = @($ps4104 | Where-Object { $_.Message -match "Compress-Archive|Copy-Item|TcpClient|Connect" }).Count
} |
Format-List |
Out-File "$out\09_4104_summary.txt" -Encoding utf8

# Sysmon
$patSysmon = "powershell.exe|wmic.exe|SecurityCenter2|AntivirusProduct|\.zip|\.aes|example.com|93\.184\.216\.34|Remove-Item|Compress-Archive|Copy-Item|TcpClient"

$sysmon = Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{
    LogName="Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational"
    StartTime=$t0
    EndTime=$t1
} -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

$sysmon |
Where-Object { $_.Id -in @(1,3,11,22,26) -and $_.Message -match $patSysmon } |
Select-Object TimeCreated,Id,ProviderName,Message |
Format-List |
Out-File "$out\10_sysmon_relevant.txt" -Width 4000 -Encoding utf8

$sysmon |
Where-Object { $_.Id -in @(1,3,11,22,26) } |
Group-Object Id |
Sort-Object Name |
Select-Object Name,Count |
Out-File "$out\11_sysmon_by_eventid.txt" -Encoding utf8

# ZIP diagnóstico
Compress-Archive -Path "$out\*" -DestinationPath "$base\diag_p3v3.zip" -Force

Write-Host "DIAG ZIP creado en: $base\diag_p3v3.zip"

$jsonl = "\\VBOXSVR\Carpeta_Compartida_TFM\inbox\alerts.jsonl"

New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $out | Out-Null

# Limpiar JSONL
Clear-Content $jsonl

# Marcador temporal
$t0 = Get-Date
"START=$($t0.ToString('o'))" | Out-File "$out\00_time_marker.txt" -Encoding utf8

# Ejecutar campaña
Set-ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Scope Process -Force
cd $base
.\runner_candidate\TFM_Run_All_TEC_Tests_v2.ps1 *>&1 | Tee-Object "$out\01_runner_console.txt"

$t1 = Get-Date
"END=$($t1.ToString('o'))" | Add-Content "$out\00_time_marker.txt"

# Copiar JSONL
Copy-Item $jsonl "$out\02_alerts.jsonl" -Force

# Copiar último log del runner
$latestLog = Get-ChildItem "$base\Pruebas\Logs_Pruebas_TFM\TFM_TEC_Run_CANDIDATE_v2_*.log" |
Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending |
Select-Object -First 1

if ($latestLog) {
    Copy-Item $latestLog.FullName "$out\03_runner_latest.log" -Force
}

# Resumen JSONL
$alerts = Get-Content $jsonl | Where-Object { $_.Trim() } | ConvertFrom-Json

$alerts.Count | Out-File "$out\04_alerts_count.txt" -Encoding utf8

$alerts |
Group-Object CU_ID |
Sort-Object Name |
Select-Object Name,Count |
Out-File "$out\05_alerts_by_CU.txt" -Encoding utf8

$alerts |
Group-Object SourceArtifact |
Sort-Object Count -Descending |
Select-Object Name,Count |
Out-File "$out\06_alerts_by_SourceArtifact.txt" -Encoding utf8

$alerts |
Where-Object { $_.CU_ID -in @('CU-006','CU-007','CU-008','CU-009') } |
Select-Object CU_ID,MITRE_ID,SourceArtifact,AlertName,CU_Reason,CU_Evidence |
Format-List |
Out-File "$out\07_alerts_CU006_009_detail.txt" -Width 2000 -Encoding utf8

# PowerShell 4104
$pat4104 = "SecurityCenter2|AntivirusProduct|Get-CimInstance|Get-WmiObject|wmic|Win32_Service|Get-ChildItem|Remove-Item|ForEach-Object|Compress-Archive|Copy-Item|TcpClient|Connect|AES|CryptoStream|CreateEncryptor|\.aes"

$ps4104 = Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{
    LogName="Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational"
    Id=4104
    StartTime=$t0
    EndTime=$t1
} -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

$ps4104 |
Where-Object { $_.Message -match $pat4104 } |
Select-Object TimeCreated,Id,Message |
Format-List |
Out-File "$out\08_powershell_4104_relevant.txt" -Width 4000 -Encoding utf8

[PSCustomObject]@{
    CU006_4104 = @($ps4104 | Where-Object { $_.Message -match "SecurityCenter2|AntivirusProduct|Get-CimInstance|Get-WmiObject|wmic|Win32_Service" }).Count
    CU007_4104 = @($ps4104 | Where-Object { $_.Message -match "AES|CryptoStream|CreateEncryptor|\.aes" }).Count
    CU008_4104 = @($ps4104 | Where-Object { $_.Message -match "Get-ChildItem|Remove-Item|ForEach-Object|-Force" }).Count
    CU009_4104 = @($ps4104 | Where-Object { $_.Message -match "Compress-Archive|Copy-Item|TcpClient|Connect" }).Count
} |
Format-List |
Out-File "$out\09_4104_summary.txt" -Encoding utf8

# Sysmon
$patSysmon = "powershell.exe|wmic.exe|SecurityCenter2|AntivirusProduct|\.zip|\.aes|example.com|93\.184\.216\.34|Remove-Item|Compress-Archive|Copy-Item|TcpClient"

$sysmon = Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{
    LogName="Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational"
    StartTime=$t0
    EndTime=$t1
} -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

$sysmon |
Where-Object { $_.Id -in @(1,3,11,22,26) -and $_.Message -match $patSysmon } |
Select-Object TimeCreated,Id,ProviderName,Message |
Format-List |
Out-File "$out\10_sysmon_relevant.txt" -Width 4000 -Encoding utf8

$sysmon |
Where-Object { $_.Id -in @(1,3,11,22,26) } |
Group-Object Id |
Sort-Object Name |
Select-Object Name,Count |
Out-File "$out\11_sysmon_by_eventid.txt" -Encoding utf8

# ZIP diagnóstico
Compress-Archive -Path "$out\*" -DestinationPath "$base\diag_p3v3.zip" -Force

Write-Host "DIAG ZIP creado en: $base\diag_p3v3.zip"
DetectionLogic: 4104 + strong crypto regex; priority over CU-008/CU-009 when crypto is present
FalsePositiveReduction: May match legitimate encryption tools; no script-name or lab-path dependency
